```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)


#---------------- TICK SETUP ----------------

ticks <- read.csv(
  "/usr4/ugrad/neochatt/TickForecast/Data/tickLong.csv"
) |>
  mutate(
    collectDate = as.Date(collectDate),
    year = year(collectDate)
  ) |>
  filter(
    scientificName == "Ixodes scapularis",
    lifeStage == "Nymph"
  )


deer <- ticks |>
  arrange(siteID, collectDate) |>
  group_by(siteID, collectDate) |>
  summarise(
    count = sum(processedCount, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year = year(collectDate),
    DOY = yday(collectDate)
  ) |>
  filter(
    year >= 2016,
    year <= 2025
  ) |>
  drop_na(
    siteID,
    collectDate,
    year,
    DOY,
    count
  )


#---------------- OTHER DATA ----------------

doy <- read.csv(
  "/usr4/ugrad/neochatt/TickForecast/Data/DOYs.csv"
)


retreat <- read.csv(
  "/usr4/ugrad/neochatt/TickForecast/Data/RETREAT.csv"
)


lat <- read.csv(
  "/usr4/ugrad/neochatt/TickForecast/Data/UPDATED_FINAL_bounders.csv"
) |>
  group_by(siteID) |>
  summarise(
    latitude = mean(
      c(
        latitude_top_left,
        latitude_bottom_right
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


#---------------- DATA SETUP ----------------

dat <- doy |>
  left_join(retreat) |>
  inner_join(
    lat,
    by = "siteID"
  )


deer <- deer |>
  filter(siteID %in% dat$siteID)


#---------------- LIKELIHOOD ----------------

estim <- function(theta, data) {

  beta0 <- theta[1]
  beta1 <- theta[2]

  # Forces the quadratic DOY effect to curve downward
  beta2 <- -exp(theta[3])

  # Center and scale DOY
  x <- (data$DOY - 180) / 100

  psi <- plogis(
    beta0 +
      beta1 * x +
      beta2 * x^2
  )

  detected <- as.integer(data$count > 0)

  nll <- -sum(
    dbinom(
      detected,
      size = 1,
      prob = psi,
      log = TRUE
    )
  )

  return(nll)
}


#---------------- MODEL SETTINGS ----------------

years <- 2016:2025

start_date <- as.Date("2016-01-01")
end_date <- as.Date("2025-12-31")

sites <- intersect(
  unique(dat$siteID),
  unique(deer$siteID)
)


#---------------- OUTPUT OBJECTS ----------------

rmse_doy <- data.frame()
fit_summary <- data.frame()


#---------------- FIT EACH SITE ----------------

for (s in sites) {

  # All real observations from 2016–2025 at this site
  if(s != "TREE"){
    site_dat <- deer |>
      filter(
        siteID == s,
        year %in% years
      ) |>
      arrange(collectDate)
  } else {
    site_dat <- dree |>
      filter(
        year %in% years
      ) |>
      arrange(collectDate)
  }
  

  if (nrow(site_dat) == 0) {
    message(
      "Skipping ",
      s,
      ": no observations"
    )

    next
  }


  #---------------- SYNTHETIC ENDPOINTS ----------------

  # Add an explicit zero at the beginning and end of
  # every year used for fitting.
  start_anchors <- tibble(
    siteID = s,
    collectDate = as.Date(
      paste0(years, "-01-01")
    ),
    year = years,
    DOY = 1,
    count = 0
  )


  end_dates <- as.Date(
    paste0(years, "-12-31")
  )


  end_anchors <- tibble(
    siteID = s,
    collectDate = end_dates,
    year = years,
    DOY = yday(end_dates),
    count = 0
  )


  anchors <- bind_rows(
    start_anchors,
    end_anchors
  )


  fit_dat <- bind_rows(
    site_dat |>
      select(
        siteID,
        collectDate,
        year,
        DOY,
        count
      ),
    anchors
  ) |>
    arrange(collectDate)

  fit_dat <- site_dat

  #---------------- OPTIMIZATION ----------------

  fit <- optim(
    par = c(
      beta0 = 2,
      beta1 = 0,
      log_curvature = 0
    ),
    fn = estim,
    data = fit_dat,
    method = "BFGS",
    hessian = TRUE
  )


  beta0 <- fit$par[1]
  beta1 <- fit$par[2]
  beta2 <- -exp(fit$par[3])

  
  fit_summary <- bind_rows(
    fit_summary,
    tibble(
      siteID = s,
  
      beta0 = beta0,
      beta1 = beta1,
      beta2 = beta2,
  
      log_curvature = fit$par[3],
  
      convergence = fit$convergence,
      nll = fit$value,
  
      AIC = 2 * fit$value +
        2 * length(fit$par),
  
      n_real_observations = nrow(site_dat),
      n_synthetic_anchors = nrow(anchors),
      n_fitting_observations = nrow(fit_dat),
  
      n_detections = sum(
        site_dat$count > 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
  
      detection_rate = mean(
        site_dat$count > 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
  
      first_observation = min(
        site_dat$collectDate,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
  
      last_observation = max(
        site_dat$collectDate,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
  )

  #---------------- OBSERVED-DATE PREDICTIONS ----------------

  # Predictions at actual sampling dates only.
  # Synthetic anchors are excluded from evaluation.
  site_dat <- site_dat |>
    mutate(
      x = (DOY - 180) / 100,

      psi_hat = plogis(
        beta0 +
          beta1 * x +
          beta2 * x^2
      ),

      detected = as.integer(count > 0)
    )


  # This is detection RMSE, not count RMSE.
  site_rmse <- sqrt(
    mean(
      (site_dat$detected - site_dat$psi_hat)^2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


  rmse_doy <- bind_rows(
    rmse_doy,
    tibble(
      siteID = s,

      RMSE = site_rmse,

      n_observations = nrow(site_dat),

      n_detections = sum(
        site_dat$detected,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      detection_rate = mean(
        site_dat$detected,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
  )


  #---------------- DAILY PREDICTION GRID ----------------

  # Generate a complete daily series from 2016–2025.
  prediction_grid <- tibble(
    date = seq(
      start_date,
      end_date,
      by = "day"
    )
  ) |>
    mutate(
      siteID = s,
      year = year(date),
      DOY = yday(date),

      x = (DOY - 180) / 100,

      psi = plogis(
        beta0 +
          beta1 * x +
          beta2 * x^2
      )
    )


  #----------------PLOT----------------

  # Increase right margin to accommodate count axis.
  par(
    mar = c(5, 4, 4, 5) + 0.1
  )


  # Left axis: fitted probability of detection.
  plot(
    prediction_grid$date,
    prediction_grid$psi,
    type = "l",
    col = "red",
    lwd = 2,
    ylim = c(0, 1),
    xlim = c(start_date, end_date),
    xlab = "Date",
    ylab = "ψ",
    main = paste0(
      s,
      ": DOY"
    )
  )


  # Add a new plotting layer for observed counts.
  par(new = TRUE)


  # Right axis: actual observed counts.
  plot(
    site_dat$collectDate,
    site_dat$count,
    type = "l",
    col = "black",
    lwd = 1,
    axes = FALSE,
    xlab = "",
    ylab = "",
    xlim = c(start_date, end_date),
    ylim = c(
      0,
      max(
        1,
        site_dat$count,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
  )


  points(
    site_dat$collectDate,
    site_dat$count,
    pch = 16,
    cex = 0.55,
    col = "black"
  )


  axis(
    side = 4,
    las = 1
  )


  mtext(
    "Observed count",
    side = 4,
    line = 3
  )


  legend(
    "topright",
    legend = c(
      "ψ",
      "Observed count"
    ),
    col = c(
      "red",
      "black"
    ),
    lty = c(1, 1),
    lwd = c(2, 1),
    pch = c(NA, 16),
    cex = 0.7
  )
}


#---------------- COMBINE OUTPUTS ----------------

rmse_doy <- rmse_doy |>
  arrange(RMSE)


fit_summary <- fit_summary |>
  arrange(siteID)


#---------------- CHECK RESULTS ----------------

print(rmse_doy)

print(fit_summary)

# A value of 0 means nominal convergence
print(
  table(
    fit_summary$convergence
  )
)

```


```{r, echo = FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(performance)
library(broom)

#---------DATA SETUP-----------------

ticks <- read.csv(
  "/usr4/ugrad/neochatt/TickForecast/Data/tickLong.csv"
) |>
  mutate(
    collectDate = as.Date(collectDate),
    year = year(collectDate)
  ) |>
  filter(
    scientificName == "Ixodes scapularis",
    lifeStage == "Nymph"
  )


deer <- ticks |>
  arrange(siteID, collectDate) |>
  group_by(siteID, collectDate) |>
  summarise(
    count = sum(processedCount, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year = year(collectDate),
    DOY = yday(collectDate)
  ) |>
  filter(year > 2015) |> 
  filter(year <= 2025) |>
  drop_na(siteID, year, DOY, count)


met <- read.csv(
  "/usr4/ugrad/neochatt/TickForecast/Data/daymetSite.csv"
)

met <- met |>
  select(
    year = X2016,
    DOY = X1,
    maxTemp = X6.45,
    minTemp = X1.24,
    siteID = BLAN
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    DOY = as.numeric(DOY),
    maxTemp = as.numeric(maxTemp),
    minTemp = as.numeric(minTemp),
    
    date = as.Date(
      paste(
        year,
        DOY,
        sep = "-"
      ),
      format = "%Y-%j"
    ),
    
    avgTemp = (
      maxTemp +
        minTemp
    ) / 2
  ) |>
  filter(
    year >= 2016,
    year <= 2025
  ) |>
  drop_na(
    siteID,
    year,
    DOY,
    date,
    avgTemp
  ) |>
  arrange(
    siteID,
    year,
    DOY
  ) |>
  group_by(
    siteID,
    year
  ) |>
  mutate(
    GDD = pmax(
      0,
      avgTemp - 4
    ),
    
    CGDD = cumsum(GDD)
  ) |>
  ungroup()


vpd <- read.csv("/usr4/ugrad/neochatt/TickForecast/Data/daymetSite_vaporPressure.csv")
vpd$date <- as.Date(vpd$Date)
vpd$VPD <- pmax(
  0,
  (
    0.6108 * exp(17.27 * vpd$tmax..deg.c. / (vpd$tmax..deg.c. + 237.3)) +
      0.6108 * exp(17.27 * vpd$tmin..deg.c. / (vpd$tmin..deg.c. + 237.3))
  ) / 2 -
    vpd$vaporPressure / 1000
)
vpd <- na.omit(vpd)





sites <- c("GREN", "HNRY", "TEA", "BLAN", "HARV", "SCBI", "SERC", "MLBS", "ORNL", "TREE")


#---------------- EXPLORE EACH SITE ----------------

rmse <- data.frame()

for (s in sites) {

  blan <- deer |> filter(siteID == s)
  temp <- vpd |> filter(siteID == s)
  
  blan <- blan |>
    group_by(year) |>
    mutate(peak_date = collectDate[which.max(count)])
  
  temp <- left_join(temp, blan, by = c("siteID", "date" = "collectDate", "year"))
  
  if(s == "MLBS"){
    temp <- temp |> filter(year >= 2018)
  }

  temp <- temp |>
    group_by(year) |>
    mutate(
      CVPD = cumsum(VPD),
      peak_date = as.Date(
        round(
          mean(
            as.numeric(peak_date),
            na.rm = TRUE
          )
        ),
        origin = "1970-01-01"
      ),
      peak_CVPD = CVPD[
        which.min(
          abs(
            as.numeric(date - first(peak_date))
          )
        )
      ]
    ) |>
    ungroup()
  
  z <- 80

  threshold_dates <- temp |>
    group_by(year) |>
    arrange(date) |>
    filter(
      CVPD >= z,
      is.na(lag(CVPD)) | lag(CVPD) < z
    ) |>
    pull(date)
  
  plot(blan$collectDate, (blan$count), type = "l", main = s)
  abline(
    v = as.numeric(threshold_dates),
    col = "blue",
    lty = 2
  )
  
  a <- yday(threshold_dates)
  b <- yday(unique(temp$peak_date))
  c <- rep(median(b), times = length(unique(temp$year)))
  d <- rep(155, times = length(unique(temp$year)))
  
  mod <- lm(b ~ a)
  
  sub = data.frame(
    siteID = s,
    rmse = Metrics::rmse(a, b),
    rmse_null = Metrics::rmse(b, c),
    rmse_doy = Metrics::rmse(b, d),
    median_peak = median(b),
    R = cor(a, b)
  )
  
  rmse <- rbind(rmse, sub)
  
}


print(rmse)
```
